name: hcoll_v5_qso2n

fill_reason.pin_bound: 127 pin bits: N 79 (sink_slot/select + clk/rst/faults) on M5 over 19.44 um = 42% of slots; 19.44 square gives ~52% util at the expected flow std (1.28x gate synth 93 um2) and 3 M5 PG stripes per net spanning 56%.

job.purpose: hard_v5 COLL q2 qslots 1-bit switch slice (NS9 ND15, bit 544), 1x in q2; every output a flop Q.

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL already registers every port at the face: qslots_output captures captured/captured_slot/sink_slot/sink_select into _p flops before any logic; dst_v/dst_d/select_fault/unavailable_fault are flop Q. Recipe-2 output stage on: io_flop_at_pins anchors only the OUTPUT launch flops at their pins (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE), pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs give one launch flop per output pin; inputs keep their inhold pad.

structural_change: Coordinator one-pass qso resize after the qso3w/qso2w FLOORPLAN_MARGIN verdicts (flow std = 1.28x gate synth): expected flow std ~119 um2 = 40% at 21.6x21.6 -> 19.44x19.44 (core 229 um2, ~52%), same RTL, pin faces, recipe. Plus the recipe-2 output stage (io_flop_at_pins on outputs only, pin_reg_split, keep_pin_regs) so dst launch meets the native 220-ps budget (qcap twin failed launch 240.4 without it).
